import json,urllib.request
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/snapshot",timeout=5) as r:
    snap=json.loads(r.read().decode())
life=snap["lifecycle"]
assert life["full_chain_status"]=="NOT_PROVEN"
assert life["model_execution_architecture"]["target"]=="SOL_DIRECT_ASTRA_CODEX"
assert life["model_execution_architecture"]["sol"]["codex_required"] is False
assert life["model_execution_architecture"]["astra"]["codex_required"] is True
assert life["current_candidate"]["state"]=="ARCHITECTURE_MIGRATION_SOL_DIRECT"
assert life["invariant"]=="NO_TEST_OR_MEASUREMENT_BEFORE_ASTRA_POSTBUILD_APPROVAL"
print("E138_DASHBOARD_SOL_DIRECT_TARGET_OK")
